ai_summary: **Executive Summary:**  Accelya Solutions India Limited has recommended a final dividend of ₹35 per share for the financial year 2025-26. This proposed dividend, if approved by shareholders at the Annual General Meeting, will have a record date of October 9, 2026, and is scheduled for payout on November 17, 2026, signaling a positive return to eligible investors. The document itself, dated July 29, 2026, acts as a forward-looking intimation of these planned corporate actions, with no immediate red flags identified beyond the standard requirement for shareholder approval.
